evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest complete minute (not a new-hour 0.00 placeholder). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window (~358 samples), so earlier hours fall out of the file.
